title: JOFOC for Data Analysis for Quality, Safety & Oversight of the ESRD, Transplant, and OPO Programs
description: The contractor will provide detailed data reports about End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD) facilities (commonly referred to as dialysis facilities), Transplant Programs, and Organ Procurement Organizations (OPOs) in formats that are useful to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), states, health care providers, and the general public. These reports will include summaries of patient characteristics, facility characteristics, patient outcomes, and facility practice patterns. These reports will include comparative state, network, regional, and national statistics as appropriate. These reports will be used by CMS in overseeing the quality and safety of the ESRD, Transplant and OPO Programs. For the Dialysis Facility Reports (DFRs), the contractor will use data from a variety of sources to create summary reports to be used to provide Federal, state and facility oversight of dialysis facilities. Data from all available sources, including the CMS Central Data Repository (CDR), claims forms, eligibility forms, clinical data sources, facility inventories, death forms, and survey and certification forms will be updated, edited, validated, and utilized by the contractor to create a series of reports that will assist CMS, states, and other entities in monitoring the care provided by ESRD facilities. These reports will be risk-adjusted and facility, state, regional, and corporate-specific for each fiscal year. The reports shall include a rank-ordered Outcomes List of ESRD facilities for each state. The Outcomes Lists will be constructed from a composite of data elements that most validly and reliably identify facilities with potential problems. The contractor will routinely revise the DFRs to ensure they are 1) aligned with the ESRD Survey process, 2) provide development of data sources and data tools to allow state surveyors convenient and timely access to more current dialysis facility quality outcomes, 3) use state surveyor and other DFR user feedback to determine the need for revisions. The contractor will provide guidance on using advanced technologies and incorporate plans to integrate emerging technologies associated with Electronic Health Records (EHRs). The contractor will prepare Transplant Program reports and OPO reports. The data for these reports will be obtained from the Scientific Registry of Transplant Recipients (SRTR) of the Health Resources and Services Agency (HRSA), the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), and Multiple Cause of Death (MCOD) databases. This data will be used in the calculation of annual OPO performance measure scores as required by the CMS regulations at 42 CFR �486.318.

The existing domestic hot water heating systems at the Lyons VA Medical Center consist of aging tank type and semi-instantaneous water heaters and associated recirculation pumps that are inefficient, and beyond their intended service life. These units serve critical patient care, residential, and support areas and must be upgraded to meet current VA design standards, energy efficiency requirements, and plumbing and electrical codes while maintaining continuous hot water service to the occupied facility. The water heaters shall be replaced sequentially so that only one unit is taken out of service at a given time, and the others remain in full operation. This approach will ensure continuous domestic hot water service to the building throughout construction, with at least one operational hot water heater. Replacing these units will significantly reduce maintenance time, improve system control and enhance the distribution of hot water across rooms, floors, and departments. The contractor shall completely prepare site for building operations, including demolishing selected existing water heaters, recirculation pumps, and associated steam, condensate, and domestic water piping and furnish and install new semi-instantaneous steam to hot water heaters, recirculation pumps, condensate receiver/pump, piping, insulation, electrical feeders, disconnects, and controls as indicated in the 100% construction documents. Work also includes startup, testing, balancing, commissioning and training the VA plumbing staff on the new equipment. title: Canada – Public relations services – Policy Dialogue and Public Diplomacy Facility for Canada
description: The purpose of this procurement is to procure services that strengthen and deepen EU–Canada relations on key priority themes of shared strategic interest, while advancing EU interests and values in Canada through targeted policy dialogue and public diplomacy. The contract will support the implementation of commitments under the EU–Canada Strategic Partnership Agreement (SPA), the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA), and, where relevant, other bilateral frameworks including the EU–Canada Green Alliance and the EU–Canada Security and Defence Partnership. The procured services shall comprise two complementary components: Policy Dialogue Support — facilitation of structured policy dialogues across a wide range of areas through concrete activities linked to existing and emerging dialogue mechanisms, including joint committees and working groups involving the EU Delegation and relevant EU services. Public Diplomacy Actions — Design and delivery of public diplomacy initiatives aimed at increasing understanding of EU policies and priorities among Canadian audiences, demonstrating the tangible benefits of the EU–Canada partnership, and strengthening engagement with key Canadian stakeholders beyond government — including media, academia, civil society, youth, and opinion leaders. The services shall deliver measurable policy outcomes, consolidate trusted stakeholder networks, and amplify EU positions across Canada. Through the combined effect of policy dialogue and public diplomacy, the procurement aims to enhance the visibility and credibility of the EU in Canada and contribute to closer alignment between EU and Canadian policy positions and approaches, including in multilateral fora, on major foreign policy priorities.

Market research confirmed that the required records are maintained exclusively by the State of California and are not available from other sources in the required format. The contract includes a 12-month Base Period and four 12-month Option Periods. The Base Period value is $10,074.43, and the total potential contract value, is $49,012.15. description: Предмет на настоящата обществена поръчка е доставка на специализирано лабораторно оборудване и консумативи за молекулярно-биологичен анализ, което да позволи на високо научно ниво да се дефинира влиянието на променливи фактори, обусловени от климатичните изменения, върху генетичния отговор на лозята, включително експресията на гени, свързани с устойчивост към биотичен и абиотичен стрес, както и ранно откриване на патогени (вируси, бактерии, фитоплазми и гъби) по лозата. Поръчката включва следните обособени позиции: Обособена позиция №1: „Доставка на консумативи за PCR и Real time PCR за текуща лабораторна работа“; Обособена позиция №2: „Доставка на ламинарни боксове (микробиологичен клас II А2 и за PCR) и лабораторна камина“; Обособена позиция № 3: „Доставка на общолабораторно оборудване“; Обособена позиция № 4: „Доставка на Автоклав“; Обособена позиция № 5: “Доставка на олигонуклеотиди (PCR праймери)”. ​​​​Дейността се финансира като част от проект „Адаптиране на лозарството към изменението на климата чрез прилагане на екосистемни мерки за поддържане на икономическата жизнеспособност (VitiClimRoBg–Hard ROBG00370)“, по Програма Interreg VI-A Румъния-България, специфична цел: 2.4 — Насърчаване на адаптирането към изменението на климата, предотвратяването на риска от бедствия и устойчивостта, като се вземат предвид екосистемни подходи. Специализираното оборудване, обект на настоящата обществена поръчка, е в интеграция с предходно заявени компоненти по проекта, за да се постигне интегриран комплексен подход, пряко обвързан с адаптацията към климатичните изменения. Целта е допълване на теренни и физикохимични данни с молекулярно-генетичен анализ, предоставящ прецизни, възпроизводими и научно обосновани резултати, които да очертаят връзката на климатичните изменения с генетичните механизми на адаптация на лозята, генерирайки последователно прилагане на устойчиви практики за „борба“ с климатичния отпечатък и установяване на икономическа жизнеспособност.

The government will continue to monitor the updated Air Force certified equipment lists for all future purchases of this nature to verify if competition is available to include sourcing potential Governmentwide acquisition contracts and other approved vehicles. title: Systems for Phenotypic Evaluation, Clinical Trajectories, Response, and Agency (SPECTRA)
description: SPECTRA will identify and act on autism trajectories, the evolving developmental paths individuals follow across the lifespan from the prenatal period through aging, spanning autism characteristics, co-occurring conditions, and functional outcomes together with the genetic, biological, behavioral, iatrogenic (medical influences), environmental factors and their nonlinear interactions. Rather than examining these factors in isolation, SPECTRA will examine how they combine and interact, including their nonlinear interactions, to produce autism and its co-occurring conditions over time. SPECTRA will also develop technologies that serve two purposes at once: extending reliable assessment beyond the clinic while improving everyday communication, function, and quality of life. The same tools people use to live more fully will also generate the data that drive measurement and personalized care.

title: Independent Evaluation of the Better Security, Better Care Programme (October 2025 to October 2028)
description: Digital Care Hub is seeking an independent evaluation partner to assess the delivery, impact, sustainability and value for money of the Better Security, Better Care (BSBC) programme. Funded by the Department of Health and Social Care, BSBC supports approximately 28,000 CQC-registered adult social care locations in England to improve cyber security, data protection and information governance, including compliance with the Data Security and Protection Toolkit (DSPT). Delivery is led nationally by Digital Care Hub through more than 30 Local Support Organisations, combining central leadership, guidance, training, communications, data analysis and performance management with trusted local support. The supplier will design and deliver a proportionate mixed-method evaluation covering programme governance and delivery, stakeholder engagement, partner effectiveness, reach, changes in awareness and behaviour, adoption of good practice, DSPT outcomes, organisational resilience, wider benefits, cost effectiveness, return on investment and social and economic value. The work should identify lessons, good practice and evidence-based recommendations while providing ongoing insight to support continuous improvement. Key deliverables are an evaluation framework and inception report within three months; ongoing data collection, analysis and stakeholder engagement; monthly progress meetings; an interim report by September 2027; and a final evaluation report, shorter executive report, presentation and dissemination-ready outputs by October 2028. Close-down and dissemination support will continue to March 2029. The proposed contract runs from October 2026 to March 2029, with a maximum budget of £125,000 inclusive of VAT. Bidders must demonstrate strong experience in programme and economic evaluation, publicly funded programmes, mixed-method research, stakeholder engagement and report writing. Knowledge of adult social care, health and care systems, cyber security, digital transformation or information governance is required. Tender responses must include organisation and personnel details, methodology, data collection and analysis plans, delivery timetable, resourcing, quality assurance, risk management, up to three relevant examples, a full pricing schedule, assumptions and proposed social value. Evaluation weightings are: understanding 15%, methodology 35%, experience 20%, project management 10%, social value 10% and price 10%. The supplier must comply with UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, confidentiality, insurance, procurement, equality and safeguarding requirements. Clarification questions are due by 14 October 2026 and tenders by 18 October 2026. Please see attachment for full specifications.

La durée du mandat faisant l’objet du présent appel d’offres est de cinq ans, avec une option de prolongation annuelle pour une durée maximale de cinq ans supplémentaires. Požadavky na úklid se tak promítají i v rámci požadavků na ostrahu. Zadavatel dále požaduje, aby úklidové služby nebyly poskytovány pouze jako plánovaná činnost, ale aby byly schopny plnit i funkci okamžité reakce na provozní a bezpečnostní situace vznikající při provozu objektů. Zadavatel nepovažuje za dostatečné, aby úklidové služby byly poskytovány pouze v předem stanovených časech bez vazby na aktuální provoz objektu a apeluje na Dodavatele, aby úklid při čtení zadávací dokumentace nebrali jen jako „obyčejné“ úklidové služby.
